meta.purpose: Master evidence dataset for the club Persian-translation + stadium completion (SPORTSIGNAL_CLUB_PERSIAN_TRANSLATION_COMPLETION_SPEC). Every entry: dict keys (provider name forms), canonical Persian display name, current stadium (en + fa), confidence, and sources. Sources legend: FD-API=football-data.org standings pull 2026-11-21; WIKI-SEASON=English Wikipedia 2026-27 season article (stadium table); CLUB-BOX=en.wikipedia club infobox via agent-browser 2026-11-21; FA-WIKI=Persian Wikipedia article title (via en-wiki interlanguage link); TRANS=consistent Persian transliteration following repo conventions (spec 5.4 'uncertain' class unless corroborated); MEDIA=established Persian football-media form cross-checked against the repo's existing dict conventions.

confidenceLegend.verified: Persian Wikipedia title or existing curated repo entry (>=1 credible Persian-language source)
confidenceLegend.probable: Single credible source or strong consistent usage, limited corroboration
confidenceLegend.transliteration: Agent transliteration following repo conventions - flagged for review

meta.stadiumNameRules: en = current stadium name per the 2026-27 season article (club infobox for SA/CL-only clubs). fa = established Persian name for that name form where it exists, else consistent transliteration. Sponsor renames and former names are recorded in notes.
meta.faWikiPrefixNote: Persian Wikipedia club articles carry the prefix 'باشگاه فوتبال' (football club); the display name below is the title minus that prefix, per the repo dict convention of recognizable short forms.
